product.description: Genuine original HP PG03XL replacement battery (65Wh 'Shape-B' variant), 11.55V, Li-ion. Fits HP Spectre x360 15-AP011DX, 15-AP012DX and the wider 15-AP000 series (4-cell, 65Wh). Important: PG03XL exists in two incompatible shapes — this is the 65Wh Spectre x360 15-AP variant, not the 52.5Wh Pavilion Gaming variant. Also matches part numbers PG03064XL, 831532-421, 831532-422, 831758-005, 831731-850, HSTNN-LB7C, TPN-Q168. Tested before dispatch.

faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP Spectre x360 15-AP series. Note that HP reused the PG03XL part number for two different, incompatible battery shapes — this is the 65Wh version for the Spectre x360 15-AP series, not the 52.5Wh version used in some Pavilion Gaming models. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm which one you need.

faqs.question: Is this an original or compatible battery?
faqs.answer: We stock genuine OEM batteries — this is a genuine HP PG03XL (65Wh) unit.
